description: a file named like a snapshot entry whose first line is not the snapshot ownership header is foreign — here the first two lines of a real cache entry, a cache header under a snapshot name: cache refresh refuses the state directory before reading anything, KDLITH-CAC001 names the look-alike, exit 1, the look-alike is left byte-identical, and neither the cache entry nor the snapshot entry the reading would derive is written (the processing/cache/refresh-foreign shape)
